name: Sumi Tea House
fit: Tea and sake houses, ceramics, ryokan and wellness, meditation and slow-craft brands
keywords: japanese sumi ink enso brush tea ceremony cinnabar hanko vertical shippori mincho zen minimal wabi
idea: A tea house menu as a single brushstroke: one ink enso is the timer, the type is a heavy Mincho, and a cinnabar hanko seal is stamped only when the cup is ready.
note: Live: choose a tea, then Begin steeping. The ensō closes as the leaves steep (demo speed, 12×), and the red seal is stamped when it is ready.
borrowed: Sumi-e brush circles, hanko vermilion seals, vertical tategaki headings, washi paper, and the printed menu of a Kyoto tea room.
mood: Still, warm and deliberate. Big heavy serif, a lot of paper, and exactly one colour doing the work. Suits places that want to feel unhurried. Avoid for anything urgent or transactional: the pace is part of the design.

palette.name: Cinnabar
palette.role: the one accent: seal, vertical text, button

type.meta: Vertical accent · Shippori Mincho 800, writing-mode: vertical-rl

motion: The ensō draws in over 2.2s with `stroke-dashoffset`, `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`.
Steeping redraws the ring from nothing as it fills; the ring is the progress, so no separate bar.
The seal stamps in from 1.9× scale in 600ms.
watchouts: The brush edge is an SVG turbulence filter. Keep it on a single element or it gets expensive.
Cinnabar once per view. A second red thing and the seal stops meaning anything.
Do not set the Japanese in tracked caps; it is only tracked when vertical.
tokens:
--paper: #EFE8DA;  --ink: #14110F;  --cinnabar: #C8321E;  --ash: #5E574C;
--serif: 'Shippori Mincho', serif;  --sans: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', sans-serif;
